options.items: Array of StatItem { label, agg, attr?, unit? }

stats.description: A row of numbers over the rows the filters left.

options.label: Point label attribute name
options.color: Attribute name to color points by

map.description: A map with one point per entity that has a location.

table.description: A sortable, paged table; a click on a row selects it for detail.

options.top: Number of top categories to keep

chart.description: An SVG chart: y aggregated per distinct x, the largest top kept.

detail.description: Every attribute of the selected entity.

options.fields: Optional list of attributes the user may edit

form.description: A window over the selected entity with one input per field; a save changes the rows on screen.
